prompt_lines: Asset type: extra-coarse premium pixel-art consumable icon source for final native 32x32
Input images: blue skill-charge battery family references only.

Primary request: Create exactly one high-tier void battery whose effect makes the next skill free. It belongs to the same magical cell family but is unmistakably rarer: a broad compact dark-metal battery with reinforced four-corner clamps, a near-black glass chamber, and one central void orb made of a black core surrounded by a saturated violet ring and a tiny cold-white star highlight. Use restrained purple/cyan accents, not blue crystal.

Strict pixel-grid contract: draw as if on an 18x18 logical canvas enlarged strict nearest-neighbor. Uniform huge square pixels; object at most 16 logical pixels wide by 16 tall, at least one logical pixel empty border. Void orb at most 7x7 logical pixels. No half-size details.
Style: crisp limited-palette retro pixel art, thick near-black outline, hard edges, premium but simple, readable at 32x32.
Composition: exactly one centered battery only.
Constraints: opaque shapes, no antialiasing/blur/soft aura, no floating particles, floor, shadow, text, logo, props, or #ff00ff inside object.
Avoid: potion bottle silhouette, colorful galaxy texture, gradients, high pixel density, multiple objects.

source_selection.manual_review_note: Manual per-source review accepted the 18x26 grid. The automatic analyzer reported confidence 0.574 with near-square periods 30.7x30.2 physical pixels; the low score is caused by a local 14px Y-axis harmonic, not a continuous or ungridded illustration.
